text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today was extremely busy. Exhausted, I 
headed to the rooftop to take a break, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
How is it, Biko-chan! Did you find any bad 
guys—?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All is peaceful at the academy today! How 
are things on your end?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No proble~m! The food is delicious, 
everyone's smiling, and all is peaceful☆
choice_data_list: What do you mean by bad guys?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! I'm on patrol around the 
academy right now♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
To protect the peace of the academy! 
That's Biko-chan's daily routine!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! Bono's Trainer! Is anything 
troubling you? Any irregularities?! I 
shall lend you my strength!!
choice_data_list: I'm struggling with my lack of stamina...
Is there any way to maintain stamina?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Wait, oh no! Have you eaten yet?! I'll 
make some chanko, just wait! Hot pot, hot 
pot time!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, Bono! If you eat till 
you're stuffed, you won't be able to 
move!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
If I can't move when it counts, I won't be 
able to defeat the bad guys...! I've gotta 
build up my basic stamina!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: ...Or so Carrotman said!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, hmm! So if I just move a whole lot 
and eat a whole lot! How's that!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like a plan! Then the three of us 
will patrol the academy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! Trainer, let me know if you get 
tired! I'll support you! â

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Biko Pegasus's suggestion, we ended up 
patrolling the academy grounds while being 
pushed along by Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All clear!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All cleaar☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Alright, next up!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: All cleaaar!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: All clear♪

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, so peaceful!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, we looked everywhere— until my 
stamina finally hit its limit, and I ended 
up slumping to the ground.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Mmh, are you all right!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! Trainer, hang in there! I'll carry 
you on my back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could say that taking a rest 
would make me fine, Hishi Akebono picked 
me right up.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Bono is amazing as always! Her fundamental 
stamina is rock solid!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~. Maybe I built up even more stamina 
today ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer, thanks for keeping me company 
today!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Once we get back, I'll make you a 
delicious meal, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grateful for Hishi Akebono's kindness, I 
rested my weary body and enjoyed a 
delicious dinner.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Meat!! Eating meat will fix you right up☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Right! Carrotman's curry had huge chunks 
of meat in it too! Bono, let's eat right 
away!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me~☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You have to take your time and chew your 
food thoroughly! That way, the nutrients 
circulate properly through your whole 
body—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It gives you so much energy!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Super, huh! Sounds great!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"It's easy to digest, which means you'll 
get hungry again soon, right?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I get it now! I just gotta eat more and 
get my energy back!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Keep that up, and your stamina will 
be totally on point too☆

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Then from now on, let's always eat before 
patrol! Something packed with chunky 
meat!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In front of an admiring, wide-eyed Biko 
Pegasus, Hishi Akebono served up the 
dishes with a warm smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A huge slab of meat and the aroma of 
curry... Just smelling it feels like it's 
boosting my stamina.

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying a meal together, the three 
of them patrolled the academy grounds 
until evening.
